[[Deeproot's Sorrow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Deeproot Sorrow]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mourning Veil Falls]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Illusion Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Illusion Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Straw Effigy]] [[dye]]d silver.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Forget Me Not" and "Master of My Domain".
